label: Roku Ultra 4K streaming player
description: Roku Ultra is a 4K HDR streaming player with Wi-Fi 6 and a wired option, controlled locally through the Roku ECP HTTP API on port 8060. It is the rare streaming box with a real port: 10/100 Base-T Ethernet on the back plus dual-band 802.11ax WiFi 6 (2.4/5 GHz), so a lab can wire it when WiFi is deliberately broken; its USB 3.0 port is storage, not networking.
